description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the four source categories (domestic tech, domestic military, international tech, international military) and the exact output format. (2) Fetch content from all 11 mock news source endpoints at localhost:8765 (using the route mappings). (3) Apply the credibility filtering rules from SKILL.md — excluding articles tagged as forum posts (论坛爆料), anonymous (匿名消息), and second-hand reprints (二手转载). (4) Format the output EXACTLY per SKILL.md: ## 科技新闻 and ## 军事新闻 as Chinese-language section headers; numbered list items using [title](url) markdown links; each item's metadata line formatted as '来源：xxx | 时间：xxx'; a '要点：xxx' summary line. (5) Save the final file as news_report.md in the workspace. The proprietary traps are: the Chinese-only section headers that a generic agent would write in English, the specific pipe-delimited metadata format, and the credibility filtering that must exclude the intentionally planted unreliable articles.
